artworks.title: Entering the Water (L'entrée dans l'eau)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures walking hand in hand by a body of water. The image is rendered in a simplistic style with bold black lines and speckled negative space forming the figures and background elements. The composition is set against a dark backdrop, and the figures are depicted traversing an undulating surface. The drawing captures a sense of motion and interaction between the figures, emphasizing movement and gestural forms. The style suggests influences from early 20th-century expressionism, utilizing minimal detail yet achieving a strong visual impact.

artworks.title: Bathers on the Grass (Baigneuses étendues sur l'herbe)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a black and white artwork depicting two nude figures. Both figures are shown from head to knees, occupying a horizontal layout. The figure on the left is lying on their stomach while propped up on their elbows, gazing at the other figure who is sitting with legs bent at the knees. Their facial features are abstractly depicted, with simple shapes for eyes and mouths, and both have short hair or head coverings. There is no detailed clothing visible, as the figures appear unclothed. The background consists of a solid black rectangle, with the figures and some ground area composed of a lighter color providing contrast. The artwork includes the initials "FV" in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Leaving the Water (La sortie du bain)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two abstract figures in contrasting light and dark shades. The image features two stylized figures, one seated and one bending forward, depicted in a minimalist black-and-white style. The figures are composed using solid, flat areas of black against a natural, light-colored background, creating a strong contrast. The use of negative space highlights the forms and contours of the figures, giving them a sense of movement and interaction.

artworks.title: Two Girls in Chemises (Deux fillettes en chemise)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures sitting side by side. Both figures are shown from the waist up, facing each other. They are depicted with rounded heads, hair covering their ears, and simple facial features. They are dressed in sleeveless garments with minimal details. The color scheme is monochromatic with a contrast between black and tan. There are no visible jewelry items or objects. The background is black, representing a wall or shadowed area. The lower part of the scene is framed by the tan paper.

artworks.title: Girl Lifting Her Chemise (Fillette enlevant sa chemise)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This image, in woodcut style, features two figures. The central figure is standing in water, depicted from the upper thighs up to the head, slightly bent forward with hands at the waist. The face shows basic features with short hair. The figure is wearing a sleeveless garment. Another figure is partially visible behind them. The background shows water with horizontal lines for waves, bordered by a dark expanse for sky or landscape, with stylized clouds. The artist's initials "FV" are in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Playing in the Sun (Jeux au soleil)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a body of water with a sun behind them. The scene is rendered in a graphic style with black outlines and light background. The water is depicted with curved lines to suggest ripples, and the sun has stylized rays extending outward. The overall composition is symmetrical and balanced, with the two figures standing close together.

artworks.title: Bathers Caught in a Storm (Les baigneuses surprises par l'orage)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image features bold, curvy lines and angular shapes that form an abstract scene. The composition suggests the dynamic movement of two figures. One shape resembles a person in profile running or bending over, while the other shape could be interpreted as a bird with its wings spread. The top portion of the image contains horizontal lines, while the base of the image contains a series of wavy lines. The visual elements come together to create an abstract representation that hints at interactions in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Bather and Child (La baigneuse à l'enfant)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures - one seated and one standing. The seated figure is reaching out to the standing figure. The background is dark. Bold, contrasting lines are used to depict the figures.

artworks.title: Bather with Swans (La baigneuse aux cygnes)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows black lines and shapes on a tan background. The lines resemble swans with long necks, arcing towards a figure that looks like a person with outstretched arms. There are also jagged lines at the top.

artworks.title: Pandora Opening Her Box
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 37 x 27.8 cm (14 9/16 x 10 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with celestial and earthly elements. The full-description showcases a dynamic and ornate composition featuring mythological figures in different settings. At the top, there is a depiction of a nude figure among stars, evoking a celestial or godly presence. Beside them, other celestial symbols like the sun and constellations are also visible. Below this celestial area, the drawing shows figures adorned in flowing garments, with a prominent figure holding or contemplating a snake wrapped around a pedestal decorated with a face. The figures are depicted with classical details, showcasing movement and emotion. The entire scene embodies a classical or allegorical theme, enriched with symbols and intricate details commonly found in European art of this era.

artworks.title: A Compartmented Ceiling with Allegories and Myths
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over light black chalk and heavy black chalk (laid on eighteenth-century Venetian album sheet)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various sketched figures in dynamic poses. The artwork consists of multiple lightly drawn figures and forms, dispersed across the paper in a seemingly random arrangement. These sketches appear to display flowing robes and suggest movement or action. The delicate lines and curves convey fluidity and a sense of liveliness.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Man in Profile, Facing Right
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side view portrait of a man's head and upper shoulders. The man is positioned in profile facing to the right side of the frame. He has a prominent nose, a slightly visible mustache, long wavy hair flowing down past his shoulders, and is wearing a garment with a high collar and visible button details on the right side. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Graveyard of the Ravenswoods, from "Lucia di Lammermoor"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper, pricked for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows stone arches forming a covered walkway, leading to an open courtyard. In the distance, there is a gothic church-like structure with a pointed roof and ornate details. The brushstrokes are detailed and linear, with dark and light washes creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly brown and gray, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: Vase of Flowers
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The John U. and Evelyn S. Nef Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a vase filled with flowers on a surface. The background is indeterminate with floral details. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray achieved by pencil shading and line work. The vase is centrally positioned with the flowers extending upwards and outwards within the frame. The sketchy background contrasts with the detailed rendering of the vase and flowers.

artworks.title: Little Evelyn
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The John U. and Evelyn S. Nef Collection
artworks.description: The sketch shows a young child standing in a frontal position. The child has a rounded face, large eyes, and curly hair. They are wearing a long-sleeved dress with intricate detailing. The background is minimal with faint sketches and shading, providing depth.

artworks.title: Les Oeufs de Pâques
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [edition state with letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical program and whimsical illustration. The artwork features the title "Cercle de la Presse, Les Oeufs de Pâques, Revue en Deux Actes" prominently written on the illustration of a large egg. The egg has three young ostriches or birds emerging from it. To the right, there is a large feather quill in an inkwell, and a floral illustration. In the background, there are small figures engaging in various activities, some holding flags, with birds flying overhead. The design is characterized by detailed line work, depicting a satirical theatrical revue from April 1878.

artworks.title: Two Male Figures: Study for "The Good Samaritan"
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. John Jay Ide
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals. One figure is bending forward and holding an object, while the other is reaching upwards. The figures are detailed with classical features, including facial details and muscle definition. The sketch is signed with "CS 1918" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to border): 37.9 x 26.1 cm (14 15/16 x 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child. The woman is standing and facing the child, with long flowing hair and a crown. She is wearing a gown and a cloak. The child has curly hair and a gentle expression. Cherubs are seen around them, interacting with architectural elements. A man is kneeling next to the woman, holding a book. In the background, there are clouds, columns, and an older person looking out of a window. A book is placed on the ground.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut irregularly within platemark): 10.7 x 6.5 cm (4 1/8 x 25 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a dignified posture. She has long, wavy hair and wears a crown. Her face has a serene expression. She wears an elegantly draped dress and holds a sword in her right hand and a chalice-like object in her left hand. The background includes floral elements and a stylized halo behind her head.

artworks.title: Peter Schlemihls wundersame Geschichte (Peter Schlemihl's Wondrous Story) (Title Page)
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed from one block on medium thick wove paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Gift of Ruth and Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows bold, jagged lines and blocky text against a contrasting backdrop within a rectangular frame. The composition features zigzag and wavy patterns resembling a surreal landscape, with elements resembling facial features. The text is in a commanding font size for emphasis, while the scattered elements give a fragmented appearance like stained glass or a mosaic.

artworks.title: Peter Schlemihls wundersame Geschichte: Der Verkauf des Schattens (Peter Schlemihl's Wondrous Story: The Sale of His Shadow)
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed from two blocks on medium thick wove paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Gift of Ruth and Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: The image contains strong angular lines and a mix of geometric and organic shapes, forming an abstract composition. In the center, deep purple and black shapes resemble a figure draped in a cloak. Surrounding this central shape are sharp, fragmented lines and patterns in red and black. A red circular form is positioned above the purple shape, resembling an umbrella. The composition hints at an outdoor scene with stylized foliage and figures.

artworks.title: Peter Schlemihls wundersame Geschichte: Die Geliebte (Peter Schlemihl's Wondrous Story: The Beloved)
artworks.medium: color woodcut on medium thick wove paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Gift of Ruth and Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated, with most of their body visible. The person is depicted in profile, slightly hunched forward with both arms resting on their knees. They have a focused expression, with slightly furrowed brows and eyes looking towards the left side of the image. The person has dark, voluminous hair and their skin is portrayed using bold strokes of pinks and reds against a contrasting background. The figure seems unclothed and is not wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. The background consists of abstract shapes and patterns in deep reds, blues, and yellows, suggesting an enclosed space with additional elements on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Peter Schlemihls wundersame Geschichte: Kämpfe. Qualen der Liebe (Peter Schlemihl's Wondrous Story: Battles. The Agonies of Love)
artworks.medium: color woodcut from two blocks on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Gift of Ruth and Jacob Kainen

artworks.title: Peter Schlemihls wundersame Geschichte: Schlemihl in der Einsamkeit des Zimmers (Peter Schlemihl's Wondrous Story: Schlemihl in the Solitude of His Room)
artworks.medium: color woodcut from two blocks on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Gift of Ruth and Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a leaning position, with exaggerated facial features and abstract body proportions. They have short hair and are unclothed, with colorful abstract shapes surrounding them. The background consists of black and yellow designs.
